text: It is two in the morning, and Aziz's phone buzzes.
prefix: It is two in the morning, and Aziz's phone buzzes.

text: A code from the bank.
prefix: A code from the bank.

text: Then another one.
prefix: Then another one.

text: He did not ask for any of them.
prefix: He did not ask for any of them.

text: Somewhere, a script types his number into the marketplace web page, again and again.
prefix: Somewhere, a script types his number into the marketplace web page, again and again.

text: Who stops it, and who stops the next step, when the script starts to guess the code?
prefix: Who stops it, and who stops the next step, when the script starts to guess the code?

text: In Lesson 10, the platform made a random code for a registration and kept it only as a digest.
prefix: In Lesson 10, the platform made a random code for a registration and kept it only as a digest.

text: This lesson shows the rules around that code: how long it lives, how many tries it gets, and how many codes one number, one address or one device can ask for.
prefix: This lesson shows the rules around that code: how long it lives, how many tries it gets, and how many codes one number, one address or one device can ask for.

text: Start with the code itself.
prefix: Start with the code itself.

text: It is random, with enough digits that a guess is very unlikely.
prefix: It is random, with enough digits that a guess is very unlikely.

text: The platform keeps it in a small table of codes in Postgres.
prefix: The platform keeps it in a small table of codes in Postgres.

text: It does not keep the code.
prefix: It does not keep the code.

text: It keeps a keyed digest of it, made with the code pepper, a secret that lives in Vault, as Lesson 8 showed.
prefix: It keeps a keyed digest of it, made with the code pepper, a secret that lives in Vault, as Lesson 8 showed.

text: So a copy of the database gives nobody a code.
prefix: So a copy of the database gives nobody a code.

text: Each new code also makes the older codes of the same journey void.
prefix: Each new code also makes the older codes of the same journey void.

text: So at any moment, one code is alive.
prefix: So at any moment, one code is alive.

text: The code is never in clear at rest, not even after it goes to TAF, and it never goes to a log.
prefix: The code is never in clear at rest, not even after it goes to TAF, and it never goes to a log.

text: When Aziz types a code, the platform compares the digests in constant time.
prefix: When Aziz types a code, the platform compares the digests in constant time.

text: A wrong code and a nearly right code take the same time to answer, so the timing tells an attacker nothing.
prefix: A wrong code and a nearly right code take the same time to answer, so the timing tells an attacker nothing.

text: Now the limits on one code.
prefix: Now the limits on one code.

text: Each is a policy that the bank sets.
prefix: Each is a policy that the bank sets.

text: The code has a short lifetime.
prefix: The code has a short lifetime.

text: It accepts only a few wrong entries.
prefix: It accepts only a few wrong entries.

text: Then the answer is: wrong code, and the number of tries that remain.
prefix: Then the answer is: wrong code, and the number of tries that remain.

text: After the last wrong entry, the code is void, and the person must ask for a new one.
prefix: After the last wrong entry, the code is void, and the person must ask for a new one.

text: A new code needs a minimum interval since the last one: ask too soon, and the answer is wait, then ask again.
prefix: A new code needs a minimum interval since the last one: ask too soon, and the answer is wait, then ask again.

text: And each journey gets only a few resends.
prefix: And each journey gets only a few resends.

text: One more limit comes from outside.
prefix: One more limit comes from outside.

text: TAF has its own lock: after a few wrong codes, it blocks the number for a while.
prefix: TAF has its own lock: after a few wrong codes, it blocks the number for a while.

text: So the platform's limit on wrong entries may never be looser than the TAF limit.
prefix: So the platform's limit on wrong entries may never be looser than the TAF limit.

text: If it were, TAF would lock Aziz out before the platform even counts.
prefix: If it were, TAF would lock Aziz out before the platform even counts.

text: So guessing one code does not work.
prefix: So guessing one code does not work.

text: But the script at two in the morning does not guess.
prefix: But the script at two in the morning does not guess.

text: It simply asks for new codes.
prefix: It simply asks for new codes.

text: That is where the rate limits come in.
prefix: That is where the rate limits come in.

text: The platform counts three things, in the time zone of the installation.
prefix: The platform counts three things, in the time zone of the installation.

text: The code requests for each phone number in one day.
prefix: The code requests for each phone number in one day.

text: The code requests for each network address in one hour.
prefix: The code requests for each network address in one hour.

text: And the registrations for each device in one day.
prefix: And the registrations for each device in one day.

text: The bank sets each limit.
prefix: The bank sets each limit.

text: The script hits the limit for Aziz's number.
prefix: The script hits the limit for Aziz's number.

text: Its next request gets one answer: too many requests, try again at the given time.
prefix: Its next request gets one answer: too many requests, try again at the given time.

text: The platform writes an audit event, and sends an event to the bank's antifraud system.
prefix: The platform writes an audit event, and sends an event to the bank's antifraud system.

text: Aziz's phone goes quiet.
prefix: Aziz's phone goes quiet.

text: Where do these counters live?
prefix: Where do these counters live?

text: In Valkey.
prefix: In Valkey.

text: A counter there can carry its own expiry, so a cool-down simply runs out by itself, and a read takes less than a millisecond, even at peak load.
prefix: A counter there can carry its own expiry, so a cool-down simply runs out by itself, and a read takes less than a millisecond, even at peak load.

text: And nothing in Valkey is the only copy.
prefix: And nothing in Valkey is the only copy.

text: Each value there either comes again from Postgres, or expires.
prefix: Each value there either comes again from Postgres, or expires.

text: I think the most important rule in this lesson is a short one.
prefix: I think the most important rule in this lesson is a short one.

text: A limit in the app is only for convenience.
prefix: A limit in the app is only for convenience.

text: The app can grey out a button, but only the server counts.
prefix: The app can grey out a button, but only the server counts.

text: The script at two in the morning never opened the app.
prefix: The script at two in the morning never opened the app.

text: It called the API directly, and the API still said no.
prefix: It called the API directly, and the API still said no.

text: The same idea guards a much more expensive call, which comes later in the course: MyID.
prefix: The same idea guards a much more expensive call, which comes later in the course: MyID.

text: The platform counts failed MyID attempts for three subjects: the phone number, the device, and the personal identification number when it is known.
prefix: The platform counts failed MyID attempts for three subjects: the phone number, the device, and the personal identification number when it is known.

text: When one subject reaches a limit, the attempt is refused.
prefix: When one subject reaches a limit, the attempt is refused.

text: There is a daily cap, a cool-down after the first counted failure, and a longer cool-down after the second.
prefix: There is a daily cap, a cool-down after the first counted failure, and a longer cool-down after the second.

text: The refusal tells the person the earliest time of the next try.
prefix: The refusal tells the person the earliest time of the next try.

text: Only a failure that the person caused counts.
prefix: Only a failure that the person caused counts.

text: A face that does not match counts.
prefix: A face that does not match counts.

text: MyID being down does not.
prefix: MyID being down does not.

text: An operator can reset the counters, with a reason.
prefix: An operator can reset the counters, with a reason.

text: And test customers are never counted.
prefix: And test customers are never counted.

text: To recap.
prefix: To recap.

text: One code, kept as a keyed digest, with a short life and only a few tries.
prefix: One code, kept as a keyed digest, with a short life and only a few tries.

text: Rate limits for the number, the address and the device.
prefix: Rate limits for the number, the address and the device.

text: Counters and cool-downs in Valkey, and every decision on the server.
prefix: Counters and cool-downs in Valkey, and every decision on the server.
